buidl.reason: Intentional cryptocurrency slang for contributing to the ecosystem; preserve this spelling even though it is a transposition of build.

buidling.reason: Documented inflection of intentional cryptocurrency slang BUIDL; preserve this spelling rather than correcting it to building.

surender.reason: Given name, as used by Surender Baswana; preserve it rather than interpreting it as a misspelling of surrender.
